name: BlastOff FutureYield minting vault repay without owner check
summary: LockedStakingPools.repayWithStakeToken() let any caller repay the outstanding future-yield debt of any stake position and paid that position's full stake to the caller, with no check that the caller owned it. Attackers paid the small remaining debt on other users' locked ETH and USDB positions and took the stakes.
notes: Reset: the anchor repaid only pool 1 positions; addLockedPools listing pool 1 (ETH, 5-year lock) came 56 minutes after the 2024-03-01 upgradeTo that installed implementation 0x0832e17e, so the listing sets the age (pool listing as a HIGH market listing, rule 8). Pool 2 (USDB), drained later in the campaign, was listed on 2024-03-05.

Campaign: every Repay event (Etherscan logs; the Blast RPC's eth_getLogs silently omits ranges) whose position owner, per getStakeInfo/Stake, differs from the transaction sender: nine transactions by 0x67933cf0 through contract 0x75cdcd8f and one by 0x6a87708f (150 ETH for a 30 ETH repay). Loss is the vault's net outflow (the stakes); the repay amounts went to the protocol treasury and are not subtracted. The attacker's own 0.0001 ETH and 0.0001 USDB positions repaid in 0x60d8622b and 0x1435bea2 are excluded.
